notes.title: The Toys Update + Quarry Payload Return - v35.0
notes.content:
Hyper Dash brings you new toys to play with…literally. Quarry Payload makes a triumphant return, and with the new Amethyst DLC Bundle you will tackle the battlefield with all the clarity in the world. Welcome aboard a brand-new Hyper Dash update!

[h2]Introducing, Toys! Taunt. Troll. Dominate.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39374358/83190daa5abff25060a4f67867960f4a37fc57ea.png[/img]

Play around, or taunt and troll your enemies and teammates with our first ever batch of Toys in Hyper Dash! Spread joy with a Confetti Gun, support friends with a Finger Glove, provide a sick beat with Maracas or Bongos, and create a symphony on the Harmonica, Trombone, or Triangle.

We also have a present for you, come play Hyper Dash NOW & claim your Triangle Toy for FREE before this offer expires. We are Triangle Factory after all…

[h2]Welcome Back, Quarry Payload![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39374358/d75eae6353281a9d9851a0ace6a6777ac08eeeb7.png[/img]

Quarry Payload is officially BACK, and it’s back for good! We’ve made some tweaks to make sure the map is a bit more balanced this time around. Let us know what you think, and if there’s any more changes that are needed.

[h2]Say hello to the Amethyst DLC Bundle![/h2]

Refine your weaponry with the Amethyst bundle for a quartz-like aesthetic, and rain down purple on your enemies. Many believe these lavender crystals invoke protection, promote clarity, and keep you calm and composed. All qualities that could be useful in the chaos of the arena! These skins feature bright violet muzzle flashes, magical chiming gun sounds, and crystallized designs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39374358/3214baa64ed4310fc49a7c11e21fd10962414307.png[/img]

As always, let us know what you think about the update on Discord (http://hyperdashvr.com/discord) and our socials, and see you all in the next update!

Happy dashing!

-TF

notes.title: Halloween Map Is Back!
notes.content:
Hey 💥BOO💥

After we scared ourselves with a false start, I'm happy to say Halloween Map is now live until the 4th of November. 👻

# v33.1

## Improved
* Lower CP target to 250 points.

## Fixed
* Reintroduced the Halloween map.
* Fixed some platform code that boot-locked the game when it failed.
* Fixed holes in all maps.
* When you log in we now make sure you actually have all the skins you should have received.  
* Private servers will now select a new admin if the current admin is no longer present after a server restart.

notes.title: The Social Hubdate!
notes.content:
The Social Hubdate for Hyper Dash is finally here! Get ready for weekly challenges, a new max level-cap at 999, a lobby overhaul with shop and customization, an in-game polling system, and more. See the full changelog in our [url=hyperdashvr.com/discord]Discord[/url]!

[h1]Who Will Be The First To Reach Level 999?[/h1]
Earlier this year, we first announced that level 100 would no longer be the maximum level in Hyper Dash in our live podcast episode. Today, is finally the day. Level up beyond level 100, and who knows, maybe you'll be the first player to reach level 999!

[h1]Introducing, Weekly Challenges![/h1]
Starting now, players can get 3 weekly challenges. When completing all 3, you automatically complete a fourth challenge, giving you double XP for your next five matches. This reward will cap at 30 matches max, to make sure you're not missing out on any rewards.

[h1]The Lobby Overhaul Is Here![/h1]
The Hyper Dash lobby has received a little bit of a makeover. The victory room is now merged into the lobby, all guns have been added, and we brought the shop and customization into the lobby.

We're eager to hear what you think of this update. Feel free to leave us your thoughts in our [url=hyperdashvr.com/discord]Discord[/url], and be on the lookout for more updates soon!

-TF

notes.title: Hyper Dash - v29.4.0 - Volcano Map update
notes.content:
[h3]The Volcano Map Update[/h3]
A couple of months ago, the Discord community voted on what gamemode should get a new map, with Domination winning in the poll. Today, we're launching a brand-new update for Hyper Dash, including our new Volcano map on Domination, eight new weapon skins and a bunch of new features!

[b]Changelog: v29.4.0 - Volcano[/b]

[i]Added[/i]
- Community-voted map "Volcano", featuring Domination.
- 8 new weapon skins.
- On-Screen HUD, displaying the same info as on the arm-HUD.
- Option toggle to enable/disable the On-Screen HUD.
- Option slider to adjust the scale/size of the On-Screen HUD.
- Option slider to adjust resolution up-sampling. (Trade battery life for crisper visuals)
- Option slider to adjust Horizontal gun angle.
- Option toggle to disable game music, but keep the winning/losing/game-over sounds.
- New Energy Recharge sound.

[i]Fixed[/i]
- Removed point buttons A and C in Sudden Death mutator.
- Fixed multiple issues in maps and levels.
- Fixed a Spawn killing/infinite experience exploit.
- Fixed an issue where certain players were able to walk through spawn doors.
- Fixed an issue where certain individuals couldn't join the same server.
- Training mutators now correctly toggles between enable and disable.
- Infinite sprinting no longer drops below 0 energy.
- Movement no longer continues when opening oculus menu.
- Crouch circle no longer persists in main menu.
- Stability improvements focused on boot exceptions.
- Arm HUD now remains when dead.
- HUD that follows the player no longer freaks out when looking fully down.
- Domination countdown now has precedence over the first kill voice line.

[i]Improved[/i]
- Revamped the item store. It now features all available skins, including a rotating skins-on-sale selection.
- Voice chat stability improvements and updated the audio plugin.
- AFK players are now more reliably kicked.
- Redesigned the server filters UI.
- Updated Oculus SDK and implemented player report button.
- Added back kick from session button and made ban from session button more clear.
- Server property details like 'Level Range', 'Version' and 'Mutators' have moved to the Join button.

notes.title: Hyper Dash - Free To Play Update
notes.content:
We shared this news a while ago, and you all knew it was coming, but today is the day! Hyper Dash is now officially FREE TO PLAY on Quest & Steam!

Spread the word and tell your friends, because now you can dash, sprint, shoot & rail grind your way to victory in all our game modes, free of charge! Everyone who bought the game before the free to play update will be reimbursed the purchase price in in-game credits, which you can spend to your heart’s content in the store! The free to play update on Pico and Vive will follow ASAP.

We’re looking forward to both welcoming new players and seeing familiar players return. Thank you for playing, thank you for supporting our game, and have all the fun between the upcoming festivities! Merry Christmas!
